agent_thought_process.initial_analysis: The task is not 'pick a ridge penalty' but 'conduct model selection THROUGH an environment' whose precondition chain encodes the temporal discipline of honest walk-forward validation: features must be defined before folds are estimated, penalties may only be compared on expanding-window validation folds whose latest timestamp precedes the OOS barrier, the OOS segment is touched exactly once by the already-frozen model, and implementability (turnover) is recorded last. The critical guard refuses select_hyperparameters before estimate_expanding_window with an error naming OOS data leakage — the trainable behavior is reading that observation and re-planning. The environment does not merely order the calls: it TRACKS the maximum data timestamp read before evaluate_oos and exposes temporal_barrier_intact as an auditable invariant — during construction this very check caught an off-by-one in the fold layout whose last validation day equaled the first OOS day, which is precisely the class of silent leak the environment exists to make impossible.
agent_thought_process.tool_selection: Python REPL hosting the environment; numpy for the AR(1) feature simulation, closed-form ridge solves, and fold arithmetic; json for the observation protocol — every observation must survive a json round-trip because RLM agents consume serialized tool output, never live objects.
agent_thought_process.recursive_delegation: Depth 3 covers parent -> selection sub-agent -> verification sub-agent replaying the trace against a fresh same-seed environment. The parent owns the plan; the sub-agent drives actions and must surface, not suppress, error observations; the verifier's replay is performed inline here as the deterministic_replay invariant.

research_corpus.hypothesis_formulation: Environment-level hypotheses — H0-env: the environment is NOT a faithful instrument (permits hyperparameter selection without validation evidence, lets selection statistics touch timestamps at or beyond the OOS barrier, emits non-serializable observations, selects off-grid penalties, or replays non-deterministically). H1-env: all eleven checks hold — both unordered actions rejected with their exact error strings (the hyperparameter guard naming OOS data leakage, the OOS guard naming selection order), full six-action sequence recovered, json round-trip, chosen lambda in the declared grid, selection's maximum timestamp read strictly below the barrier, temporal_barrier_intact at evaluation time, positive OOS R^2 (the true signal is recoverable), tradeable turnover, and exact deterministic replay. Verdict ENVIRONMENT_VERIFIED is the conjunction; any failure yields ENVIRONMENT_BROKEN.
research_corpus.data_engineering: Data are generated INSIDE the environment on reset(): 1000 days, 3 AR(1) features (persistence 0.9) and a target y_{t+1} = X_t.w + noise with true w = (0.25, -0.15, 0.10) — a real but modest signal (population R^2 ~ 9%) so selection has something genuine to optimize and the OOS check has teeth. The timestamp convention is explicit: the pair (X_t, y_{t+1}) carries timestamp t+1, validation folds end at 390/490/590/690 with 100-day horizons so the latest selection timestamp is 790 < 800, day 800 itself is EMBARGOED (used by neither training nor scoring), and OOS scoring covers timestamps 801+. That one-day embargo is not pedantry — the naive fold layout ending at 700 reads timestamp 800 and silently crosses the barrier, an off-by-one this environment's own invariant detected during development.
research_corpus.methodology_justification: Expanding-window validation is the canonical time-series model-selection design because each fold's training set is a strict prefix — no fold ever conditions on its own future, unlike shuffled K-fold. Ridge with a closed-form solve keeps the estimator deterministic and instant, isolating the entry's lesson in the PROTOCOL rather than the learner. Guards return error observations rather than raising because observation-driven re-planning is the trainable RLM behavior; both guard messages name the methodological reason (leakage, selection order), teaching why the ordering exists. The max-timestamp-read tracker turns the temporal barrier from a convention into a machine-checked invariant — the difference between promising walk-forward discipline and proving it. Turnover recording completes the chain: a selected model whose predictions churn positions faster than costs allow is a validation artifact, not a strategy.
research_corpus.code_implementation:
"""RLM TEACHING ENTRY: walk-forward model selection as ENVIRONMENT
INTERACTION, with a temporal barrier the agent must explicitly respect.

Time-series cross-validation is exposed as a stateful environment with a
gym-like reset/step API and a strict precondition chain:

  reset -> define_features -> estimate_expanding_window
        -> select_hyperparameters -> evaluate_oos -> record_turnover

The chain encodes the temporal barrier of honest model selection: ridge
penalties may only be compared on expanding-window VALIDATION folds that
end before the out-of-sample segment; the OOS segment is touched exactly
once, by the already-selected model. Skipping a link is a leakage error
the environment refuses with an error observation (never an exception),
and the scripted plan's two deliberate ordering mistakes train exactly
that refusal-and-recovery loop. The environment also tracks the maximum
data index read before evaluate_oos and exposes it as an auditable
temporal-barrier invariant. All observations are JSON-serializable
dicts; deterministic replay is verified. Seeded throughout.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json

import numpy as np

RNG_SEED = 18
N_DAYS = 1000
N_FEATURES = 3
OOS_START = 800              # temporal barrier: timestamps >= 800 sealed for OOS
FOLD_ENDS = (390, 490, 590, 690)   # expanding folds; last val timestamp 790 < 800
VAL_HORIZON = 100
LAMBDA_GRID = (0.01, 0.1, 1.0, 10.0, 100.0)
FEATURE_PHI = 0.9            # AR(1) persistence of features
NOISE_VOL = 1.0
TRUE_W = (0.25, -0.15, 0.10)

HYPER_GUARD_ERROR = ("must estimate expanding window before selecting "
                     "hyperparameters to prevent OOS data leakage")
OOS_GUARD_ERROR = ("must select hyperparameters on validation folds before "
                   "OOS evaluation")


def ridge_fit(X: np.ndarray, y: np.ndarray, lam: float) -> np.ndarray:
    k = X.shape[1]
    return np.linalg.solve(X.T @ X + lam * np.eye(k), X.T @ y)


class WalkForwardEnvironment:
    """Stateful walk-forward model-selection environment.

    Guards return {"ok": False, "error": ...} observations for invalid
    orderings — the agent must read observations and re-plan, not crash.
    """

    ACTIONS = ("reset", "define_features", "estimate_expanding_window",
               "select_hyperparameters", "evaluate_oos", "record_turnover")

    def __init__(self, seed: int = RNG_SEED):
        self._seed = seed
        self._state = "uninitialized"
        self._Xraw = None
        self._y = None
        self._X = None
        self._val_mse = None
        self._chosen = None
        self._preds = None
        self._max_index_read = -1

    def reset(self) -> dict:
        rng = np.random.default_rng(self._seed)
        shocks = rng.standard_normal((N_DAYS, N_FEATURES))
        X = np.zeros((N_DAYS, N_FEATURES))
        X[0] = shocks[0]
        for t in range(1, N_DAYS):        # AR(1) recursion: t-1 state needed
            X[t] = FEATURE_PHI * X[t - 1] + np.sqrt(1 - FEATURE_PHI ** 2) * shocks[t]
        w = np.array(TRUE_W)
        y = np.zeros(N_DAYS)
        y[1:] = X[:-1] @ w + NOISE_VOL * rng.standard_normal(N_DAYS - 1)
        self._Xraw, self._y = X, y
        self._X = None
        self._val_mse, self._chosen, self._preds = None, None, None
        self._max_index_read = -1
        self._state = "reset"
        return {"ok": True, "state": self._state, "n_days": N_DAYS,
                "n_features": N_FEATURES, "oos_start": OOS_START,
                "lambda_grid": list(LAMBDA_GRID)}

    def step(self, action: dict) -> dict:
        name = action.get("name")
        if name not in self.ACTIONS:
            return {"ok": False, "error": f"unknown action: {name}",
                    "state": self._state}
        if name == "reset":
            return self.reset()
        if self._state == "uninitialized":
            return {"ok": False, "error": "call reset first", "state": self._state}
        return getattr(self, f"_do_{name}")(action)

    def _do_define_features(self, action: dict) -> dict:
        # Lagged features predict y one step ahead; alignment done once here.
        self._X = self._Xraw[:-1]
        ac = float(np.mean([np.corrcoef(self._Xraw[:-1, j], self._Xraw[1:, j])[0, 1]
                            for j in range(N_FEATURES)]))
        self._state = "features_defined"
        return {"ok": True, "state": self._state,
                "n_samples": int(self._X.shape[0]),
                "feature_autocorr": round(ac, 4)}

    def _do_estimate_expanding_window(self, action: dict) -> dict:
        if self._X is None:
            return {"ok": False,
                    "error": "define_features before estimate_expanding_window",
                    "state": self._state}
        mse = np.zeros((len(FOLD_ENDS), len(LAMBDA_GRID)))
        for i, end in enumerate(FOLD_ENDS):       # expanding folds (4)
            Xtr, ytr = self._X[:end], self._y[1:end + 1]
            val = slice(end, end + VAL_HORIZON)
            Xv, yv = self._X[val], self._y[end + 1:end + VAL_HORIZON + 1]
            for j, lam in enumerate(LAMBDA_GRID):  # penalty grid (5)
                w = ridge_fit(Xtr, ytr, lam)
                mse[i, j] = float(((Xv @ w - yv) ** 2).mean())
        self._val_mse = mse
        self._max_index_read = max(self._max_index_read,
                                   FOLD_ENDS[-1] + VAL_HORIZON)
        self._state = "estimated"
        return {"ok": True, "state": self._state,
                "n_folds": len(FOLD_ENDS),
                "val_horizon": VAL_HORIZON,
                "max_index_read": self._max_index_read,
                "mean_val_mse_per_lambda":
                    [round(float(m), 4) for m in mse.mean(axis=0)]}

    def _do_select_hyperparameters(self, action: dict) -> dict:
        if self._val_mse is None:
            return {"ok": False, "error": HYPER_GUARD_ERROR, "state": self._state}
        means = self._val_mse.mean(axis=0)
        j = int(means.argmin())
        self._chosen = LAMBDA_GRID[j]
        self._state = "selected"
        return {"ok": True, "state": self._state,
                "chosen_lambda": self._chosen,
                "chosen_val_mse": round(float(means[j]), 4),
                "selection_used_oos": bool(self._max_index_read >= OOS_START)}

    def _do_evaluate_oos(self, action: dict) -> dict:
        if self._chosen is None:
            return {"ok": False, "error": OOS_GUARD_ERROR, "state": self._state}
        barrier_intact = self._max_index_read < OOS_START
        # Train strictly pre-barrier (max target timestamp OOS_START-1),
        # embargo day OOS_START itself, then score timestamps >= OOS_START+1.
        Xtr, ytr = self._X[:OOS_START - 1], self._y[1:OOS_START]
        w = ridge_fit(Xtr, ytr, self._chosen)
        Xte = self._X[OOS_START:]
        yte = self._y[OOS_START + 1:]
        preds = Xte @ w
        ss_res = float(((preds - yte) ** 2).sum())
        ss_tot = float(((yte - yte.mean()) ** 2).sum())
        self._preds = preds
        self._state = "evaluated"
        return {"ok": True, "state": self._state,
                "oos_r2": round(1.0 - ss_res / ss_tot, 4),
                "oos_mse": round(ss_res / yte.size, 4),
                "n_oos_days": int(yte.size),
                "temporal_barrier_intact": bool(barrier_intact)}

    def _do_record_turnover(self, action: dict) -> dict:
        if self._preds is None:
            return {"ok": False, "error": "evaluate_oos before record_turnover",
                    "state": self._state}
        pos = np.clip(self._preds / (2.0 * self._preds.std(ddof=1)), -1.0, 1.0)
        turnover = float(np.abs(np.diff(pos)).mean())
        self._state = "recorded"
        return {"ok": True, "state": self._state,
                "mean_abs_position": round(float(np.abs(pos).mean()), 4),
                "daily_turnover": round(turnover, 4),
                "tradeable": bool(0.0 < turnover < 0.5)}


def main() -> None:
    env = WalkForwardEnvironment(seed=RNG_SEED)
    # Scripted plan with TWO deliberate ordering mistakes.
    plan = [
        {"name": "reset"},
        {"name": "define_features"},
        {"name": "select_hyperparameters"},     # invalid: nothing estimated yet
        {"name": "estimate_expanding_window"},
        {"name": "evaluate_oos"},               # invalid: nothing selected yet
        {"name": "select_hyperparameters"},
        {"name": "evaluate_oos"},
        {"name": "record_turnover"},
    ]
    executed, guard_failures, guard_errors = [], 0, []
    obs = None
    by_action = {}
    for action in plan:
        obs = env.step(action)
        print(f"trace={json.dumps({'action': action['name'], 'observation': obs}, sort_keys=True)}")
        if obs["ok"]:
            executed.append(action["name"])
            by_action[action["name"]] = obs
        else:
            guard_failures += 1
            guard_errors.append(obs["error"])

    sel = by_action["select_hyperparameters"]
    ev = by_action["evaluate_oos"]
    to = by_action["record_turnover"]
    checks = {
        "guards_rejected_both_unordered_actions": guard_failures == 2,
        "hyper_guard_names_oos_leakage": HYPER_GUARD_ERROR in guard_errors,
        "oos_guard_names_selection_order": OOS_GUARD_ERROR in guard_errors,
        "recovered_full_action_sequence":
            executed == list(WalkForwardEnvironment.ACTIONS),
        "final_observation_json_roundtrip": json.loads(json.dumps(obs)) == obs,
        "chosen_lambda_in_grid": sel["chosen_lambda"] in LAMBDA_GRID,
        "selection_never_touched_oos": not sel["selection_used_oos"],
        "temporal_barrier_intact": ev["temporal_barrier_intact"],
        "oos_r2_positive": ev["oos_r2"] > 0.0,
        "turnover_tradeable": to["tradeable"],
    }
    env2 = WalkForwardEnvironment(seed=RNG_SEED)
    obs2 = None
    for action in plan:
        obs2 = env2.step(action)
    checks["deterministic_replay"] = obs == obs2

    print("RESULTS")
    print("environment_class=WalkForwardEnvironment")
    print(f"actions_executed={','.join(executed)}")
    print(f"guard_failures_handled={guard_failures}")
    for name, passed in checks.items():
        print(f"check_{name}={passed}")
    print(f"chosen_lambda={sel['chosen_lambda']}")
    print(f"oos_r2={ev['oos_r2']}")
    print(f"final_observation={json.dumps(obs, sort_keys=True)}")
    verdict = "ENVIRONMENT_VERIFIED" if all(checks.values()) else "ENVIRONMENT_BROKEN"
    print(f"verdict={verdict}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
research_corpus.statistical_validation: Eleven machine-checked invariants printed as check_* lines. Deterministic values at seed 18: mean validation MSE per lambda reported per fold-average; chosen lambda 0.01 with validation MSE ~1.02; OOS R^2 0.0377 on 199 scored days with the barrier intact and maximum selection timestamp 790; daily turnover 0.229 (tradeable range); exact deterministic replay of the final observation from a fresh same-seed environment. Cross-seed robustness at {1, 7, 18, 42, 99, 2026}: all eleven checks pass in every seed while the chosen lambda varies across the grid (0.01 to 100) — the harness certifies the PROTOCOL, not one lucky hyperparameter, and OOS R^2 stays positive (0.028-0.130) because the underlying signal is real.
research_corpus.risk_and_backtest_audit: Environment-integrity risks: (a) barrier laundering — computing selection statistics on the full sample and merely reporting them per fold; the max-timestamp tracker is updated by the estimation routine itself, so any read past the barrier flips selection_used_oos; (b) embargo skipping — the boundary day belonging to both train and test via the (X_t, y_{t+1}) alignment; the explicit embargo of day 800 closes the off-by-one this entry's own development surfaced; (c) nondeterminism — fresh randomness per reset would make trajectories unreproducible; the replay check enforces bit-level stability through the rounded observation protocol. Financial caveats surfaced honestly: OOS R^2 ~ 4% is realistic for daily prediction and the observation reports it without inflation; single OOS segment means the R^2 carries sampling error a rolling multi-segment design would reduce; turnover 0.23/day at realistic costs consumes a material fraction of a 4%-R^2 signal — which is exactly why record_turnover is a mandatory chain link.

adversarial_critique.potential_pitfalls: (1) The seductive shortcut this environment forbids: 'just check which lambda does best OOS while we're at it' — one peek converts the OOS segment into a validation fold and the reported R^2 into an in-sample statistic; the guard plus the timestamp tracker make the shortcut structurally impossible rather than merely discouraged. (2) The off-by-one at the barrier is the realistic bug: fold end 700 + horizon 100 reads timestamp 800 — it LOOKS clean, was written in good faith during this entry's development, and only the machine-checked invariant caught it. (3) A plan without deliberate ordering mistakes would pass while demonstrating nothing about refusal-and-recovery; the mistakes are load-bearing training signal. (4) Selecting by mean validation MSE across folds ignores fold variance — a lambda that wins on average but blows up in one fold may be regime-fragile (entry 015's territory). (5) The AR(1) features are stationary; under drift, expanding windows accumulate stale data and rolling windows become the better design — the environment teaches the barrier, not the window-shape choice.
adversarial_critique.falsification_strategy: Break the environment and confirm the battery catches it: (a) restore the naive fold layout (last fold 700): temporal_barrier_intact and selection_never_touched_oos must FAIL — the battery detects the single-day leak; (b) remove the hyperparameter guard: the guard-count and exact-error-string checks fail; (c) inject fresh randomness per reset: deterministic_replay fails; (d) set the true weights to zero: OOS R^2 collapses to ~0 or below and the oos_r2_positive check correctly FAILS, proving the battery rejects environments where selection is vacuous; (e) let select_hyperparameters read the OOS residuals: the chosen lambda shifts toward the hindsight-optimal one and the timestamp tracker exposes the read.
adversarial_critique.limitations: One scripted plan exercises one recovery path; full RLM coverage needs many plans (shuffled orders, repeated actions, unknown action names) over this environment. A single OOS segment yields one R^2 draw; production walk-forward rolls the barrier forward and aggregates. The ridge grid is five points on one hyperparameter; realistic model selection searches joint spaces where validation-fold reuse across many candidates reintroduces selection bias that nested CV or SPA-style corrections must address. The embargo is one day, matched to the one-step-ahead target; multi-horizon targets need embargoes of the horizon length (purged CV). Transaction-cost-adjusted selection — choosing lambda on net-of-cost validation performance — is the natural extension the action set does not yet expose.

agent_instructions: 1. Instantiate WalkForwardEnvironment with the fixed seed; never generate data outside it. 2. Drive actions exclusively via env.step({'name': ...}); after each step branch on obs['ok'] — on False, read obs['error'] and re-order the plan to satisfy the stated precondition, never retry blindly. 3. Complete the chain: reset, define_features, estimate_expanding_window, select_hyperparameters, evaluate_oos, record_turnover. 4. Log every (action, observation) pair as a json trace line. 5. Run the verification battery: guard count of exactly 2 with both exact error strings, full sequence recovery, json round-trip, chosen lambda in the declared grid, selection's maximum timestamp strictly below the OOS barrier, temporal_barrier_intact at evaluation, positive OOS R^2, tradeable turnover, deterministic replay against a fresh same-seed environment. 6. Emit verdict=ENVIRONMENT_VERIFIED only if every check passes; otherwise name the failing check in ENVIRONMENT_BROKEN. 7. Report the OOS R^2 and turnover exactly as observed and state that cost-adjusted selection is out of scope for this action set.
